notes.zh-CN: 从桌面输入框按 Enter 或点击发送后，对话自动滚动到底部，显示最新消息。手机端可实时逐字查看电脑发来的回复。 macOS 为 universal 开发签名，未公证。Windows 安装包未签名。Android APK 为调试签名。iOS IPA 为开发签名，仅供团队已注册设备安装。
notes.en: Sending from the desktop composer with Enter or the Send button scrolls the conversation to the latest message. The mobile app shows desktop replies as they stream. The universal macOS app is development-signed and unnotarized. Windows installers are unsigned. The Android APK is debug-signed. The development-signed iOS IPA installs on registered team devices.
